chunks: And as for what was narrated - Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Safwan ibn Yahya from Abdullah ibn Muskhan from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdullah who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'A man marries off his slave girl to a free man or a slave; is he entitled to take her back without divorce?' He said, 'Yes, she is his slave girl; he takes her back whenever he wishes.'

key_terms.يَنْزِعَهَا: he takes her back / reclaims her

ai.seo_question: Can a master take back his slave wife from her husband without divorce?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the master's right of 'inzis' (reclaiming) is absolute and does not require the husband's consent or a formal divorce decree, as the marriage is derivative of his ownership. This ruling highlights the distinct legal status of *milk al-yamin* marriages in Shia jurisprudence, where the master's will supersedes the marital bond, distinguishing it from free marriages which require formal dissolution.
